forms.name: Petrified Rod
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Insect
Glaive for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Rod
forms.text:
The Petrified Rod's final form.
A product of the Wycademy's
tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Rod
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Fader Rod
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive known for its
light yellow feathers. Loved by
many for its ease of use.

forms.name: Scale Fader
forms.text:
The Fader Rod's final form.
Its vivid Maccao feathers cut
down those in their way.

forms.name: Escama Fader
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fader Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Bolt Chamber
forms.text:
A terrifying weapon that steals
energy from its prey, driving it
into an odd, pulsating device.

forms.name: Full Bolt Chamber
forms.text:
The Bolt Chamber's final form.
It sucks in the blood of its prey
before striking from the sky.

forms.name: Surge Chamber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bolt Chamber</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Scythe
forms.text:
A glaive made for hunting in
the dark. Even the blackest of
nights cannot hide its victims.

forms.name: Evening Calm
forms.text:
The Hidden Scythe's final form.
The darkness of night silences the
vain screams of its victims.

forms.name: Avidya Scythe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Scythe</COL>.

forms.name: Altair
forms.text:
A glaive powerful enough to cut
even the wind. Evading repeatedly
while drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Alteal
forms.text:
The Altair's final form. When
wielded in battle, it cuts down
its sworn enemies with ease.

forms.name: Alteal Rebellion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Altair</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Breaker
forms.text:
A balanced, deadly Insect Glaive.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Lana Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Breaker's final
form. The weapon of choice for
the rebels of the world.

forms.name: Sedition Queller
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Breaker</COL>.

forms.name: Kut-Ku Pike
forms.text:
A glaive based on a Yian Kut-Ku
striking at a Konchu. Its flashy
decorations rally spirits.

forms.name: Toucan Pike
forms.text:
The Kut-Ku Pike's final form.
There is no escape from the
vicious strike of its beak.

forms.name: Flamebeak Pike
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kut-Ku Pike</COL>.

forms.name: Royal Bloom
forms.text:
A glaive made from light and
pliable Royal Ludroth parts. Its
swings leave a watery trail.

forms.name: Bloom Royale
forms.text:
The Royal Bloom's final form.
The water it retains lets it
create rainbows with each swing.

forms.name: Waterspout Bloom
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Royal Bloom</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Rod
forms.text:
A glaive made from a beautiful
fossil. The sparkling stone serves
as a symbol of the Kinsect.

forms.name: Relic Trias
forms.text:
The Obsidian Rod's final form.
An ancient force of nature inside
bends the will of Kinsects.

forms.name: Ethereal Trias
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Graviafaren
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made with tough
Armor Wyvern bones. Hits with the
force of a charging Gravios.

forms.name: Gravordius
forms.text:
The Graviafaren's final form.
Scatters all before its flames,
leaving only ashes behind.

forms.name: Gravid Wyvern
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Graviafaren</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Bayonet
forms.text:
A glaive made of iron. Simple,
but it possesses all the features a
hunter could ask for.

forms.name: Hiten Blade
forms.text:
The Iron Bayonet's final iteration.
Outwardly, it looks the same, but it
has received some hefty upgrades.

forms.name: Hiten Blade Kai
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Bayonet</COL>.

forms.name: Azure Bayonet
forms.text:
A bayonet-style Insect Glaive with
added Velociprey materials. It
whizzes across fields in pursuit of prey.

forms.name: General's Bayonet
forms.text:
The Azure Bayonet's final form.
Made for even more mobile pursuit
forces, it tracks targets with ease.

forms.name: Assault Serpent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Azure Bayonet</COL>.

forms.name: Crimson Fury
forms.text:
A bayonet-style Insect Glaive
fortified with Ioprey poison.
It strikes its prey like a viper.

forms.name: Vermillion Viper
forms.text:
Crimson Fury's final form. Made
of top-grade materials, its red
fangs decimate its victims.

forms.name: Sanguine Serpent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crimson Fury</COL>.

forms.name: Heaven's Rath Glaive
forms.text:
A glaive made from valuable Silver
Rathalos materials. Powerful
flames scorch all in its way.

forms.name: Unprecedented Rath
forms.text:
The Heaven's Rath Glaive's final
form. The blade glows red like
the sun and erupts in its fury.

forms.name: Propagation
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Heaven's Rath Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: Blossomajesty
forms.text:
A legendary Fire Wyvern Insect
Glaive. Fly through the air on
golden wings of fire.

forms.name: Universus
forms.text:
The Blossomajesty's final form.
Such magnificence seems scarcely
of this world.

forms.name: Dragonebula
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blossomajesty</COL>.

forms.name: Sand Anchor
forms.text:
A Cephadrome Insect Glaive. It
attacks like tusks bursting forth
from the sand.

forms.name: Dune Anchor
forms.text:
The Sand Anchor's final form.
Its hardened fin glistens in the
sun as it flies through the air.

forms.name: Desert Anchor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sand Anchor</COL>.

forms.name: Fin Harpoon
forms.text:
A glaive that uses a beautiful
Piscine Wyvern fin to soar through
the air and destroy its foes.

forms.name: Dorsal Harpoon
forms.text:
The Fin Harpoon's final form, it
utilizes tough Piscine Wyvern
materials for peak performance.

forms.name: Plesioth Harpoon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fin Harpoon</COL>.

forms.name: Névé Rod
forms.text:
A pillar of ice to be thrust
into the earth, scattering snow
and freezing prey solid.

forms.name: Névé Frost
forms.text:
The Névé Rod's final form. It
fires frigid blasts like a Zamtrios,
hammering foes with intense cold.

forms.name: Fimbulvetr
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Névé Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Arcane Strike
forms.text:
An improved iron glaive, it is imbued
with electricity in order to add even
more damage to its attacks.

forms.name: Electric Bayonet
forms.text:
The Arcane Strike's final form.
It hits hard like lightning, ending
its prey in a swift flash.

forms.name: Electric Bayonet Kai
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arcane Strike</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Staff
forms.text:
A simple bone Insect Glaive.
Its latent power can be tapped
if upgraded correctly.

forms.name: Aerial Glaive
forms.text:
The Bone Staff's final form. It
retains the simplicity, but
boasts numerous upgrades.

forms.name: Volant
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Staff</COL>.

forms.name: Wardance Cudgel
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made of Blangonga
parts. The faces of warriors from
many snowy regions are carved into it.

forms.name: Warparty Cudgel
forms.text:
The Wardance Cudgel's final form
is said to be able to call forth mighty
snowstorms with a single swing.

forms.name: Warfeast Cudgel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wardance Cudgel</COL>.

forms.name: Shell Intoner
forms.text:
A rod used by a river people to
channel their god and receive
oracles.

forms.name: Crab Intoner
forms.text:
The Shell Intoner's final form. It
is a holy staff that some believe
has the ability to dispel evil.

forms.name: King Crab Intoner
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shell Intoner</COL>.

forms.name: Rage Cudgel
forms.text:
A glaive used in a war dance by a
tribe to quell a snow god. Its
wielder passes on divine guidance.

forms.name: Master's Rage Cudgel
forms.text:
The Rage Cudgel's final form. It
serves the one destined to rule.
It channels divine strength.

forms.name: Chieftain's Rage Cudgel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rage Cudgel</COL>.

forms.name: Needle Ivy
forms.text:
A Najarala glaive used by an
ancient war tribe. It shows two
serpents coiled about the sun.

forms.name: Needle Vine
forms.text:
The Needle Ivy's final form. Its
twin serpents depict the nature
of the wielder wading into war.

forms.name: Paralyzing Vine
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Needle Ivy</COL>.

forms.name: Sturdy Glaive
forms.text:
This bone Insect Glaive has been
crafted from bone with legendary
skill and superior quality materials.

forms.name: Sturdy Glaive Redux
forms.text:
The Sturdy Glaive's final form.
Made from the highest quality bone
for excellent Sharpness and damage.

forms.name: Stalwart Glaive
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sturdy Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Rod
forms.text:
A Brachydios Insect Glaive that
plants itself at ground zero and
consumes all with its blast.

forms.name: Electrorod
forms.text:
The Dios Rod's final form, it is
a mere precursor of the explosive
destruction that is to come.

forms.name: Electroshock Rod
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Press
forms.text:
A Brachydios Insect Glaive that
smashes into the earth, blasting
the wielder into strike position.

forms.name: Quantum Demolisher
forms.text:
The final form of the Demolition
Press. It has unleashed its hidden
destructive power on the earth.

forms.name: Quantum Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Press</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Press
forms.text:
Lightbreak weapons sunder the
planet's crust to unleash magma
from the depths of hell.

forms.name: Lightbreak Furnace
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Press's final form.
Magma bursts from the ground and
scorches the surface of the world.

forms.name: Lightbreak Scoria
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Press</COL>.

forms.name: Deep Blue Glaive
forms.text:
A midnight-blue Insect Glaive.
Folk legends still speak of its
use in ritual rain dances.

forms.name: Midnight Glaive
forms.text:
The Deep Blue Glaive's final form.
It calls forth rain to answer the
prayers of a parched land.

forms.name: Zaffre Glaive
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Deep Blue Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: Flaming Halberd
forms.text:
A glaive augmented by Agnaktor
parts, its reddish color burns
into the eyes of those who see it.

forms.name: Blazing Halberd
forms.text:
The Flaming Halberd's final form,
it's an even deeper crimson that
bewitches with its fiery beauty.

forms.name: Inferno Halberd
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flaming Halberd</COL>.

forms.name: Diablos Rod
forms.text:
A would-be tyrant must first
conquer his followers, and
the world will follow after.

forms.name: Tyrant Rod
forms.text:
The Diablos Rod's final form and an
even stronger Diablos glaive.
Shatters bones and lives alike.

forms.name: Horned Tyrant
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diablos Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Sky-high Glaive
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive with traditional
ornamentation. It paints mesme-
rizing yellow swaths in the air.

forms.name: Highest of Glaives
forms.text:
The Sky-high Glaive's final form.
With a flash of its golden blade,
prey drop like flies before it.

forms.name: Stratosphere Glaive
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sky-high Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: Mind Stick
forms.text:
A legendary glaive that aided a
priest on his journey westward.
Owns the battlefield.

forms.name: Mind Stick "Stone"
forms.text:
The Mind Stick's final form. Gods
of the west imbue it with the power
to smite any and all foes.

forms.name: Mind Stick "Rock"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mind Stick</COL>.

forms.name: Hortadent
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made to look just
like a beetle. Its wriggling jaws are
not for the squeamish.

forms.name: Hortadent Brada
forms.text:
The Hortadent's final upgrade.
Its improved jaws are capable of
ripping its prey to shreds.

forms.name: Altaroth Trident
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hortadent</COL>.

forms.name: Sect Happa
forms.text:
A glaive with cruel talons on
both edges. Light and strong, its
use requires graceful movement.

forms.name: Belsect Happa
forms.text:
The Sect Happa's final form. It
features incredibly hard talons
that effortlessly slice through prey.

forms.name: Virismo Belsect
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sect Happa</COL>.

forms.name: Trim Happa
forms.text:
A glaive with hidden talons upon
which fresh blood still lingers.
Their red flash tears prey apart.

forms.name: Cannibal Happa
forms.text:
The Trim Happa's final form.
Its blood-soaked talons glow
in the darkness.

forms.name: Dual Talon Cannibal
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Trim Happa</COL>.

forms.name: Acorn Rod
forms.text:
A weapon created by a Felyne,
inspired by the sharp edges of
an acorn.

forms.name: Meownster Club
forms.text:
The Acorn Rod's final iteration.
Monsters will stop in their tracks
upon seeing this weaponized nut!

forms.name: Meownster Masher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Acorn Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Magia Pitareen
forms.text:
A glaive made following ardent
requests from female hunters. The
perfect blend of form and function.

forms.name: Magia Crescent
forms.text:
The Magia Pitareen's final form.
Guaranteed to be the hottest
item for this hunting season.

forms.name: Magia Finale
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Magia Pitareen</COL>.

forms.name: Fox Halberd
forms.text:
A glaive owned by a warrior
that served his lord to the death.
Its blade dances like the wind.

forms.name: Curved Naganagi
forms.text:
The Fox Halberd's final form. It
blossoms in battle like a cool wind
that sweeps across the entire field.

forms.name: Eventide Kazanagi
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fox Halberd</COL>.

forms.name: Astalos Cudgel
forms.text:
A glaive made from materials
of the brutal Astalos. Powerful
lightning eliminates its prey.

forms.name: Thunderstorm Cudgel
forms.text:
The Astalos Cudgel's final form.
The green blade blazes bright
with lightning before it strikes.

forms.name: Thunder Dragon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Astalos Cudgel</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Cudgel
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive said to have been
used by a shrine maiden. It does
the work of the gods themselves.

forms.name: Colossus's Cudgel
forms.text:
The Giant's Cudgel's final form. It
echoes with the hum of insects
of the maidens' final charge.

forms.name: Behemoth's Cudgel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Cudgel</COL>.

forms.name: Flaming Teuza
forms.text:
A glaive that was formed from
the fire of a Glavenus that soars
through the heavens above.

forms.name: Glavenus Helldait
forms.text:
A Flaming Teuza tempered into its
final form. Oh mighty Glavenus,
rain down fire from above!

forms.name: Glavenus Helldanova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flaming Teuza</COL>.

forms.name: Leumundslist
forms.text:
A dire cudgel that clouds
the air with the slain Gore
Magala's noxious vengeance.

forms.name: Leumundsgift
forms.text:
The Leumundslist's final form. The
miasma spreads throughout the land,
laying waste to all in its path.

forms.name: Leumundsbruch
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Leumundslist</COL>.

forms.name: Le Traqueur
forms.text:
The Shagaru Magala, deified
as an elegant glaive. Light
gushes with every swing.

forms.name: La Merveille
forms.text:
The final form of Le Traqueur.
This Wycademy treasure delivers
the light of salvation.

forms.name: Le Miracle
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Le Traqueur</COL>.

forms.name: Indigo Flash
forms.text:
A glaive made from Kirin
spoils. The wondrous horn-
tip is sharper than steel.

forms.name: Azure Bolt
forms.text:
The Indigo Flash's final form.
The Kirin's soul contained within
strikes foes with divine justice.

forms.name: Verdant Levin
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Indigo Flash</COL>.

forms.name: Boltbrute
forms.text:
A staff used in ancient tribal dances
to quiet the mystic beast and kiss
the earth with Thunder.

forms.name: King Boltbrute
forms.text:
The Boltbrute's final form. The
azure light of its unceasing barrage
of lightning heralds your doom.

forms.name: Emperor Boltbrute
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Boltbrute</COL>.

forms.name: Daora's Entom
forms.text:
A glaive inspired by the Kushala
Daora. It cuts through prey like
a ray of light through icy seas.

forms.name: Daora's Tethidine
forms.text:
The final form of Daora's Entom.
A single ray of light from it can
bathe the world in silvery beauty.

forms.name: Daora's Samudra
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daora's Entom</COL>.

forms.name: Caster's Rod
forms.text:
A Chameleos staff bathed in
phantom fire. The magicks in its
dance awaken ancient demons.

forms.name: Hazy Caster
forms.text:
The Caster's Rod's final form.
Its demonic powers enable it to
bend the wills of its prey.

forms.name: Veil Caster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Caster's Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Cudgel
forms.text:
This ghastly serpentine cudgel
is capable of releasing a demon
that can provide infinite strength.

forms.name: Infernal Cudgel
forms.text:
The final form of the Skeletal
Cudgel. It uses its power to slay
those that deal in arrogance.

forms.name: Rasalhague Cudgel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Cudgel</COL>.

forms.name: Polaris Zimbal
forms.text:
A cosmic weapon that summons
the children of the stars in order
to convey the will of the heavens.

forms.name: Zimbal Cudgel
forms.text:
The Polaris Zimbal's final form.
It searches out evil to
dispel in the name of truth.

forms.name: Zimgaroa Cudgel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Polaris Zimbal</COL>.

forms.name: Push Broom
forms.text:
A glaive that was widely used to
shovel snow, its tips are frozen
solid and sharp as steel.

forms.name: Stain Remover
forms.text:
The Push Broom's final form.
Cleans even the dirtiest scales,
readying them soon after carving.

forms.name: Filth Abolisher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Push Broom</COL>.

forms.name: Deathport Staff
forms.text:
A weapon based on the staff of an
infamous tyrant. Those that see it
bow down and beg for forgiveness.

forms.name: Garamorse
forms.text:
The Deathport Staff's final form.
Instills fear in all that behold
its cold and penetrating gaze.

forms.name: Darkmorse
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Deathport Staff</COL>.

forms.name: Black Rod
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive infused with a dark
power. It eventually overcomes its
wielder, staining their soul with evil.

forms.name: Onyx Rod
forms.text:
The Black Rod's final iteration. It
possesses even more of the sinister
force that eats away at one's soul.

forms.name: Fatalis Glaive
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Garia Club
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive that was slowly
cooked over an open fire. It has
the perfect flavor and heat.

forms.name: Garia Chachamba
forms.text:
The Garia Club's final form. It has
been cooked further to make it even
more delicious, juicy, and gruesome.

forms.name: Prime Garia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Garia Club</COL>.

forms.name: Stealth Glaive
forms.text:
A strong and flexible glaive. Upon
drawing it, its prongs deploy and
release Nerscylla pheromones.

forms.name: Stealth Glaive Redux
forms.text:
The Stealth Glaive's final form.
The weapon of choice of a secret
society of Insect Glaive wielders.

forms.name: Shadow Walker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stealth Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: Eldora Scepter
forms.text:
Made by peddlers from items they
found. Its ornamentation calls to
mind some long-lost royal house.

forms.name: Bygone Scepter
forms.text:
The Eldora Scepter's final form.
Its gleaming crown speaks to
the glory of an empire long fallen.

forms.name: Pride of Agaltia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eldora Scepter</COL>.

forms.name: Metal Mauler
forms.text:
A yellow-striped cudgel that
combines ogreish strength and
insect power to conquer all.

forms.name: Metalmangler
forms.text:
The Metal Mauler's final form,
a weapon of sheer destruction that
obliterates all who oppose it.

forms.name: Metal Mutilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Metal Mauler</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Cudgel
forms.text:
A golden, grisly cudgel that
rises angrily into the sky like
lightning returning to heaven.

forms.name: Demonlord Grudgel
forms.text:
The Demonlord Cudgel's final
form. It can engulf the entire
land in its destructive wake.

forms.name: Demonlord Bludgel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Cudgel</COL>.

forms.name: Research Glaive
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive which doubles as
a sextant for observing the
heavens. Essential for night flights.

forms.name: Discovery Glaive
forms.text:
The Research Glaive's final form. A
wise person always knows where
they are and where they're going.

forms.name: Authority Horizon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: Conviction Glaive J
forms.text:
The Insect Glaive of a pirate
who took the path of treason.
Many innocents fell victim to it.

forms.name: Condemnation Glaive J
forms.text:
The Conviction Glaive J's final
form, capable of awakening
the world from deep slumber.

forms.name: Judgment Glaive
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Conviction Glaive J</COL>.

forms.name: Aladdin's Wand
forms.text:
A wand symbolizing Rukh. It
bathes its wielder in the noble
and merciful glow of kindness.

forms.name: Aladdin's Wand X
forms.text:
Aladdin's Wand's final form.
The strong will housed within it
will guide the land to salvation.

forms.name: Aladdin's Wand XX
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aladdin's Wand</COL>.

forms.name: Spear of the Beast
forms.text:
A weapon that uses the power of
souls to slay demons. It provides
its wielder with extreme power.

forms.name: Spear of Rebirth
forms.text:
The final form of the Spear of the
Beast channels the rage of multiple
people to increase its power.

forms.name: True Beast Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spear of the Beast</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Staff
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white
god's twelfth power: dance.
The god's messengers foretell doom.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skytraveler
forms.text:
The Ukanlos Staff's final form. The
white god's dance serves as an
omen of the land's destruction.

forms.name: Ukanlos Worldtraveler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Staff</COL>.

forms.name: Alatreon Dragonspire
forms.text:
An Alatreon Insect Glaive that
gives off a faint gleam as it toys
with its opponents in battle.

forms.name: Alatreon Embrace
forms.text:
The Alatreon Dragonspire's final
form. It eats away at the soul and
lures it into the dark abyss.

forms.name: Alatreon Godslayer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alatreon Dragonspire</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Glaive
forms.text:
Shines with the silvery hue of the
Argent Comet. Its relentless blows
hit with the force of a supernova.

forms.name: Dragonstar Shuma
forms.text:
The Silverwing Glaive's final form.
"Fear me, the star-splitter; as with
the body, so with the core."

forms.name: Magnastar Lev
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Rod
forms.text:
A Soaratorium Insect Glaive for
hunters breaking new ground. It
deals a furious flurry of attacks.

forms.name: Sage Rod
forms.text:
The Elder Rod's final form.
All are entranced by its artful
thrusts and cuts.

forms.name: Philosopher Rod
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Assault Glaive
forms.text:
An extravagant, potent model that
controls powerful bugs with better
scent delivery.

forms.name: Forewalker
forms.text:
The Assault Glaive's final form
comes equipped with an upgraded
pheromone dispersal mechanism.

forms.name: Nercharybdis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Assault Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: List/Confiance
forms.text:
A glaive whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Bruch/Logique
forms.text:
The List/Confiance's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who would transcend logic.

forms.name: Wehmut/Merveille
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>List/Confiance</COL>.

forms.name: Stratus Arc
forms.text:
Used by the sky gods to bring
floods down onto a corrupt
and depraved civilization.

forms.name: Cirrus Tears
forms.text:
The Stratus Arc's final form.
The gods' divine retribution
cleansed humanity of misfortune.

forms.name: Empyrean Storm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stratus Arc</COL>.

forms.name: Goldglaive
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of wings that
beat out a hymn of sorrow.

forms.name: Inscribed Aset
forms.text:
The Goldglaive's final form.
Wielded by a fertility goddess
in defense of the throne.

forms.name: Mehet-Uret
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldglaive</COL>.

forms.name: True Fatalis Teni
forms.text:
The art of the Insect Glaive is the
art of becoming the eye of a storm
of balanced yet opposing powers.

forms.name: True Fatalis Tenyu
forms.text:
The True Fatalis Teni's final form.
A furious storm of opposing forces
provides incredible power.

forms.name: True Fatalis Dyaus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>True Fatalis Teni</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner Glaive
forms.text:
Draws on the power of a crimson
Fatalis to exert dominion over
the very laws of nature.

forms.name: True Ruiner Glaive
forms.text:
The Ruiner Glaive's final form.
Its power over natural law will
lead the world into despair and ruin.

forms.name: Absolute Ruiner Glaive
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner Glaive</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Soldier
forms.text:
The judgment of an old Fatalis
descends from the heavens.
The world will be purged with light.

forms.name: Fatalis Enforcer
forms.text:
The Fatalis Soldier's final form.
The thunder of an old Fatalis brings
about both creation and destruction.

forms.name: Fatalis Overlord
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Soldier</COL>.

forms.name: Stonefist Caster
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Black Stonefist Hurler
forms.text:
The Stonefist Caster's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Flinger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stonefist Caster</COL>!

forms.name: Nightfall Scythe
forms.text:
A glaive made from Silverwind
parts. Wielding it fills the
Arts Gauge Faster.

forms.name: Morning Calm
forms.text:
The Nightfall Scythe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Mistral Scythe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nightfall Scythe</COL>!

forms.name: Grobo Blow
forms.text:
A glaive made from
Crystalbeard materials. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grobo Blow Zeta
forms.text:
The Grobo Blow's final iteration.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Grobo Blow Diamante
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grobo Blow</COL>!

forms.name: Ashen Teuza
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made of
Hellblade Glavenus parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Ashen Helldait
forms.text:
The Ashen Teuza's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Ashen Helldait Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ashen Teuza</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Reaper
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made from
Rustrazor parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Headlong Reaper
forms.text:
The Razor Reaper's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Reaper
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Reaper</COL>!

forms.name: Melancholy
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Lingering Butterfly
forms.text:
The Melancholy's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Fleeting Existence
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Melancholy</COL>!

forms.name: Boltreaver Glaive
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made from
Boltreaver parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Boltreaver Pinnacle
forms.text:
The Boltreaver Glaive's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Boltreaver Unbound
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Boltreaver Glaive</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Club
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding it fills the
Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Bludgeon
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Club's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Gambado
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Club</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Rod
forms.text:
An Insect Glaive made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding it fills
the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Mace
forms.text:
The Massacre Rod's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Bai Qi
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Rod</COL>!
